# Thoughtly

Thoughtly is a Software Development company. Thoughtly is a company that provides AI solutions to help teams achieve a follow up. Thoughtly employs 16 people (+23.1% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with an office in 41 E 11th St. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Brazil, Mexico, Nepal, and Poland).

## About

Thoughtly is revolutionizing calling by helping businesses deploy human-like AI voice agents in under 20 minutes. 

Using a no-code, drag and drop UI, users write or import the agent's script, customize the agents voice and personality, and deploy - no technical expertise required. 

Thoughtly agents come pre-skilled and are able to handle calls for Retail, Real Estate, Hospitality, Transportation, Legal, Utility, and Insurance companies out-of-the-box. 

For those customers looking to deploy AI agents without lifting a finger, Thoughtly has an Agent Accelerator Program.

# Thoughtly

Thoughtly is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Thoughtly employs 3 people, founded in 2012. Headquartered in United States, with offices in Chicago and New York.

## About

Artificial Intelligence Solutions for Enterprise to Analyze, Visualize and Summarize Text

At Thoughtly, we provide enterprise tools that leverage artificial intelligence  to rapidly ascertain actionable insight from unstructured text. 

AI for Finance: Transforming KYC, Client-Onboarding & AML Operations
Automatically aggregate content, organize various documents and generate comprehensive reports, utilizing artificial intelligence.

AI for Media:
Gain an unprecedented depth of insight into the context, themes and nuances of content. Understand what drives performance by characterizing patterns and attributes.

Automated Reporting: 
Analyze, Visualize & Characterize
Map content, discover trends, and reveal anomalies effortlessly with speed and precision.

Content Genomes:
Organize and intelligently classify content catalogs.

Textual Topographies:
Visually map, analyze and summarize large volumes of unstructured text. Quickly navigate and contextually assess large document sets.

By harnessing machine learning and natural language processing, our platform lends a potent perspective to assessing unstructured text. Through automated natural language analysis, our platform renders text as an interactive visual, identifies anomalies and generates useful summaries for non-technical users.
